# Moody Spurgeon MacPherson

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. ## Appearance

Moody Spurgeon MacPherson is a funny-looking boy. He has a big fat face, small blue eyes, and ears that stick out like flaps.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

## Personality

Moody Spurgeon MacPherson aspires to become a minister. He suffers from anxiety regarding his academic performance, feeling strongly that he is going to fail English history.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028)_

## History

Moody Spurgeon MacPherson once suffered a defeat in a fight against [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md) after claiming that [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) put on airs about her recitations.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002)_
